purpose: internal exploratory discussion; not a publication-compliance claim

statistics.estimand: arithmetic mean over the first pass of 100 unique questions
statistics.repeat_policy: 140 extra rows retained in CSV but excluded from all plotted means/CI
statistics.message_interval: none; plotted message size is the first-pass arithmetic mean
statistics.ci_limit: question-sampling uncertainty; not hardware-repeat variability or a significance test

units_and_semantics.quality: standard HotpotQA token F1 in [0, 1], not author threshold pass rate
units_and_semantics.time: complete pipeline seconds from raw C/Q; separately logged instrumentation overhead removed
units_and_semantics.time_exclusions: model load and calibration excluded; both sender and receiver computation included
units_and_semantics.message: logical payload includes tensors or UTF-8 text plus necessary metadata; KiB=bytes/1024
units_and_semantics.deployment_limit: one shared frozen weight copy on one GPU; not original two-model memory or network speed

encoding.layout: three aligned horizontal dot panels; message panel contains a separate zero column
encoding.zero_policy: no artificial positive substitute; separate zero-only axis

alt_text_zh: 三面板横向点图，比较七种两节点通信方法的标准F1、完整计算秒数与逻辑消息KiB。前两项给出首遍100题的均值和95% bootstrap区间；消息正值用log10轴，无通信零值单独列出。结果仅用于内部讨论，未测跨机器网络传输。

visual_review.notes: PNG visually reviewed: Chinese text legible, no label clipping or footer overlap, separate zero column, quality and time intervals visible. Internal discussion figure; publisher/accessibility certification not performed.
